requirements.text: Главная цель плана — предзаказы недельного набора хлеба (Loaf Box).
requirements.taskQuote: pre-orders of the weekly Loaf Box

requirements.text: В плане есть хорошие посты о том, как пекут хлеб.
Посты ведут людей на страницу предзаказа.
requirements.taskQuote: send people to the pre-order page

requirements.text: Предложено несколько вариантов дизайна слайдов на выбор.
requirements.taskQuote: a few slide designs to choose from

lenses.title: Рост нового аккаунта
lenses.duty: Найти, что помешает этому плану вырастить совсем новый аккаунт Instagram маленькой пекарни (ни одного поста, несколько подписчиков) и удерживать аудиторию пять недель.
procedure: Read the strategy section of the owner's page in full and write down the formats, frequency, rubrics, targets and review rules it promises.
Walk through all 30 posts in order (date, format, rubric, hook) and count reels, carousels and single posts; compare the counts with what the strategy promises.
Read the hooks and look at the slides as a stranger scrolling the feed would, and note which would not stop the scroll.
Check how the first two weeks are supposed to reach people with zero followers: hashtags, places, collaborations, stories, pinned posts.
Compare every number in the strategy (counts of posts, reels, targets, dates) with the plan itself and with the samples; a number stated in two places must agree.
checklist: Will the plan grow a new account and keep people for five weeks?
Is the mix of reels, carousels and single posts, the frequency and the posting time stated and followed?
Are hooks and covers strong, and are the recurring rubrics varied enough across all 30 posts?
How does the account get reach in its first two weeks from zero (hashtags, places, joint posts, neighbours)?
Are the targets (followers, pre-orders) realistic, and is there a rule for revising the plan when they are missed?
Do different parts of the work contradict each other?
What is missing that a growth plan for a new account needs?

minimum.rule: Every post: date, format, rubric and hook.
The strategy section in full.
Every sample caption in full.
Open at least 2 slide images, including B1.

lenses.title: Путь к предзаказу
lenses.duty: Найти каждое место, где зритель, который хочет заказать набор хлеба, не может дойти от поста до страницы предзаказа или получает повод не заказывать.
procedure: List every call to action of the plan: the cta and cta_text fields of every post, the sample captions, the owner page and the rules.
For each call to action, follow the path to the pre-order page step by step: which link, which word to write, which page; use the order-page source for the texts the browser renders.
Check that every call-to-action word and link is written the same way in every place it appears (posts, samples, the owner page, the rules).
Read the offer as a doubtful buyer: what is in the box, what does it cost in total, when does it close, how do I get it; note every objection the work leaves unanswered.
Check how pre-orders are counted and what happens when the owner answers his open questions in different ways.
checklist: Are the offer and the answers to objections clear: contents, price, delivery or pick-up, closing time?
Does every call to action lead to a working pre-order page, and is its link spelled exactly like the real one?
Is every call-to-action word and link named identically everywhere it appears?
Is it defined how pre-orders are counted, with targets and a rule for changing the plan?
Are there proof posts (real customers, real boxes), and does the path to a pre-order work whatever the owner answers to his open questions?

minimum.rule: Fields cta and cta_text of every post.
Every sample caption, including its call to action.
The owner's page in full, including every link.
Open slides B1, B2 and B3.
The texts of the pre-order page as they are in the order-page source.
The price list: box contents and closing time.

lenses.title: Язык и единые формулировки
lenses.duty: Найти каждую языковую ошибку в английских текстах и каждое место, где один и тот же факт назван по-разному.
procedure: Read every hook and every sample caption sentence by sentence for grammar: agreement, tense, articles, punctuation.
Read the outline of every post for the same errors and for unclear wording.
Check the terms across the whole work: the same name for the same thing (Loaf Box, pre-order, pick-up), one style of quotation marks, one way to write prices.
Read the owner-facing text (what is needed from the owner, the rules) for plain wording without jargon.
checklist: Grammar: agreement of subject and verb, tense, articles, plural forms.
Natural wording and consistent terms (Loaf Box, pre-order, pick-up, closing time).
Prices are written the same way everywhere.
The text for the owner is simple, without jargon.
Contradictions in meaning and promises the text makes to the reader.

minimum.rule: hook and outline of every post.
Every sample caption in full.
Every item of what is needed from the owner.
Every rule on the page.

lenses.title: Слайды на экране телефона
lenses.duty: Найти каждую видимую на телефоне проблему слайдов: нечитаемый текст, сломанная вёрстка, пропавшие или разные элементы бренда.
procedure: Open every slide image and look at it at phone size: text size, contrast, hierarchy, crop to 3:4 in the profile grid.

Put all slides of one design family side by side and compare them element by element: the footer, the logo, captions, prices and colours of each slide against its neighbours. A slide whose footer or logo differs from the others or is missing is a finding.
Compare the images on the owner's page with the slide images of the same name; note any image that differs or is not used.
Check whether the offered designs are really different options for the owner to choose from.
checklist: Readability on a phone: text size and contrast.
Crop to 3:4 in the profile grid; hierarchy; the meaning of the brand colours.
Consistency across slides: the same footer, logo, fonts and captions on every slide of a design, checked side by side.
Are the offered design options really different from each other?
Quality and fit with the brand.

minimum.rule: Open every image and compare footers, logos and captions across all slides side by side.
The images as they are placed on the owner page.

lenses.title: Факты, цены и выполнимость
lenses.duty: Найти каждое неверное число или факт, каждое обещание, которое пекарня не сможет выполнить, и каждый пост, который нельзя сделать с имеющимися данными.
procedure: Recompute every sum, price and count in the sample captions and in the outlines of the posts.
Check every price and the closing time against the price list, and the pre-order texts against the order-page source; record each command and its output.
Read the fields data and check of every post and mark the posts that need data or permissions that do not exist.
Read every promise about price, timing, delivery and quality against the sources and against ordinary advertising and consumer rules.
Check the plan's rules on photos of customers and on personal data.
checklist: Photos of customers and personal data: is the plan's rule sound, and does every post that shows people have permission?
Advertising and consumer rules: claims about quality, health, allergies, delivery times, "the best".
Is every number in the sample captions and outlines correct against the price list?
Can each of the 30 posts be made with the data that exists?
Promises about deadlines and the condition of the goods; anything that could embarrass the brand.

minimum.rule: Recompute all arithmetic in the sample captions and in the outlines.
Check at least 3 prices from the plan against the price list, with the commands in your answer.
Fields outline, data and check of every post.
The pre-order page texts: price, delivery and closing time.

lenses.title: Первый читатель
lenses.duty: Прочитать всю работу как человек, у которого есть только задание владельца, и найти, где работа не даёт того, что просили, трудна для понимания или в ней нет чего-то нужного.
procedure: Read the owner's task and list everything it asks for.
Read the owner's page from start to end as the owner will read it, then the author's notes as claims to check.
For each thing the task asks for, find where the work delivers it, and note what is missing or only partly there.
Note everything that is confusing, contradictory or unexplained on first reading.
checklist: Is every requirement of the task delivered?
Can the owner understand what to decide and what happens next?
Do the page, the plan and the slides agree with each other?
Is anything required missing?
Is anything confusing or unexplained on first reading?

minimum.rule: The owner's page in full.
The author's notes in full, as claims to check.
Every post: date, rubric and hook.
Every part of the page texts.
Every other file of the work opened once: what it is and whether it belongs to the plan.
